correctness.rationale: Maximum-modulus reduces the norm to boundary ratio R=b_a/b_b. The automorphism composition b_b(b_a^-1(w))=ω^-1 b_c(w), |c|=δ, maps R to the exact unimodular arc {ω exp(iθ): |θ|≤2asinδ} by tangents to 1-δT. Maximal real scalar phase alignment produces the displayed coefficient norm. Best approximation is the least enclosing circle of that complete circular arc, with unique center cosα if α≤π/2 and 0 otherwise. The center rotates by ω and the exact distance is sinα or 1; complex Birkhoff–James follows from distance=||b_a||=1. Coincident a=b, zero coefficients and threshold equality all checked. Independent 25 complex randomized parameter tests with a dense boundary mesh supported but do not prove the continuum result.
